{{Quote|So keep the chava chava hot for me, yes?|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Dexter Jettster|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>}}
'''Chava chava''' was a beverage served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was popular with many clients, including [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
